interest: Shows prewar U.S. fears that Japanese fishing fleets served as naval reconnaissance, and swift 1941 Mexican seizures.
overview: Docket for file 894.628 (1930-42) tracks Japanese salmon fishing off Alaska, domestic food shortages, Senator Tydings's crew-substitution allegations, Honolulu legal cases, and Mexico's December 1941 seizure of the Yoshino and Ryono.
